posts.caption: Your visit summary is more than paperwork. Here's a plain-language guide to what's in it, where to find it in the patient portal, and who to ask when something doesn't look right. #PatientEducation #HealthLiteracy
Swipe through: five questions worth writing down before your next appointment. Your care team wants you to ask. #PatientEducation #AskYourCareTeam
Primary care, urgent care or the emergency room? Our plain-language guide helps you pick the right door. #PatientEducation

Quick reminder: for anything personal about your health or your bill, please call the number on your statement or use the secure patient portal. Please don't post private details here. #PatientPrivacy
How to read your after-visit summary, step by step. Save this for your next appointment. #HealthLiteracy #PatientEducation
Protecting patient privacy is a team sport. Our compliance and care teams review public posts together before they go live. #PatientPrivacy #Compliance
Our community walking group meets weekly on the riverside path. All paces welcome, comfortable shoes recommended. #CommunityHealth
Community health talks are open to everyone. Bring your questions and a neighbor. Details are on our events page. #CommunityHealth
Our community health team partners with local organizations to bring health education closer to home. #CommunityHealth
What's one health question you wish more people asked? Tell us below and we'll answer a few in an upcoming post. #CommunityHealth
Meet the nurse practitioners who lead our primary care clinics. Our spotlight series starts with how they build trust with every patient who walks in. #ProviderSpotlight
Behind the scenes with our care coordination team: the people who connect the dots between your appointments. #ProviderSpotlight #CareTeam
Thank you to every nurse, technician and front-desk teammate who makes patients feel welcome. We see you. #CareTeam
Join a team that puts patients first. We're hiring across nursing, patient access and digital communications. Learn more on our careers page. #NowHiring #HealthcareCareers
Your next role could be here. See open positions across nursing, patient access and support services. #NowHiring
A day in the life of a patient access specialist, in 30 seconds. Open roles are on our careers page. #HealthcareCareers

Virtual Q&A: how to use your patient portal with confidence. Submit your question ahead of time on our events page. #HealthEducation

inbox.suggestedReply: Thank you for sharing it!

inbox.suggestedReply: Thank you for the kind words! We'll share this with the team.

inbox.text: @SecurePatientIT the check-in process was smooth today. Thank you!
inbox.suggestedReply: Thank you for the kind words! We'll share this with the team.

inbox.text: Thank you for the reminder email about my appointment. It really helps.
inbox.suggestedReply: We're glad it helps!

inbox.text: @SecurePatientIT what are your clinic hours on the weekend?
inbox.suggestedReply: Hours vary by location. Please check the locations page or call your clinic directly.

inbox.text: @SecurePatientIT how do I reset my patient portal password?
inbox.suggestedReply: Use the 'Forgot password' link on the portal sign-in page. If that doesn't work, call the number on the sign-in page.

inbox.text: Hi, how do I request a new appointment time? I can't make my current one.
inbox.suggestedReply: Please call our scheduling line or use the secure patient portal so we can help you safely. We can't change appointments over social.

inbox.text: @SecurePatientIT do you have openings for nurses? Where can I apply?
inbox.suggestedReply: Yes! See open positions on our careers page.

inbox.text: @SecurePatientIT I want to send you my insurance information and a photo of my card. Where should I send it?
inbox.suggestedReply: Please don't share insurance or personal details on social media. Call the number on your card or use the secure patient portal.

inbox.text: @SecurePatientIT I've been trying to understand my bill for two weeks and nobody has called me back. Very frustrating.
inbox.suggestedReply: We're sorry for the wait. Please call the billing number on your statement, or send us a direct message with your name only and we'll connect you with a billing specialist.

inbox.text: I think I was charged twice for the same visit and the billing line is always busy. Can someone help?
inbox.suggestedReply: We're sorry about this. Please share only your name here and we'll have a billing specialist reach out through a secure channel.

inbox.text: @SecurePatientIT your billing statement is confusing. I can't tell what I owe or why.
inbox.suggestedReply: We're sorry it's confusing. A billing specialist can walk you through it. Please call the number on your statement.
